facts.text: Mansfield’s Ohio State Reformatory, once a prison, later became the filming location for The Shawshank Redemption and a hotspot for paranormal tours.
The Big Spring that once fed downtown Mansfield’s early settlers is now hidden beneath Central Park, its legacy still shaping the town.
Mansfield’s Tappan Stove Company invented the first microwave oven for home use, a milestone in household technology.
Westinghouse Electric debuted Elektro, one of the earliest humanoid robots, at a Mansfield showcase that drew national attention.
The B&O Bike Trail stretches 18.4 miles through Mansfield, inviting cyclists to explore historic rail corridors and scenic river views.
Kingwood Center Gardens preserves Charles Kelley King’s estate across 47 acres, offering walking paths that echo the town’s early agricultural roots.
